title: Approval card: everything needed to approve on one screen

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Retrospective R5 (docs/review-2026-10-25-relay-retrospective.md). Approval (checkpoint 2) should show what the owner needs to decide: the gate verdict, test counts, diff stat, owner findings, UI renders and human-check items. Today human checks pile up as adj records (141-145, 147).

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/engine/engine.go:315-340` (Approve, Reject): add a fix action that sends the owner's note to a fix round (proposed).
- `internal/tui/pane.go` and `docs/dashboard.md:314` (Run detail pane): the card for an awaiting-approval run.
- `internal/daemon/runs.go`: the card's data in the run status.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Approve, reject and fix are the card's actions. Fix with a note is proposed; confirm at preflight. Renders appear when the UI-pass-renders slice lands.

Owner decisions (2026-10-26 session, AskUserQuestion): (1) fix with a note: f opens a note field; the engine runs an implementer fix round with the note, then checks and the gate, and returns to awaiting approval. (2) Human checks: the card lists the slice's [HUMAN CHECK] items, each with a checkbox; approval needs every item ticked or marked later; ork records the result as a slicer note on the slice (this replaces human-check adj records). S111 has landed; owner findings show as its structured questions. Re-anchor from the code.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: go test -race ./...; go test ./internal/tui -update then review goldens; go vet; gofmt -l; slicer check; adj lint. UI slice: UI pass (r14).
